name: (hydroxymethyl)urea
purpose: Milk body lotion can effectively moisturize the skin, provide necessary hydration, and prevent dryness and flakiness.
uses: When using body lotion, it is best to apply it evenly and carefully to ensure uniform protection and hydration of the skin, and to maintain the balance water and oil on the skin.
